title: Studio Scene Plan
description: Non-destructive scenes.json plan consumed by OpenMontage Studio's timeline editor. Media paths drive the video side only; the approved narration WAV always defines the final duration via Ajustar ao WAV.

wav.description: Optional WAV path. Relative paths resolve against the plan file's directory. Loaders must never switch the editor's active WAV without explicit user confirmation.

media.description: Path to a local image or video file. Relative paths resolve against the plan file's directory.

duration_seconds.description: Target hold for this scene. Quantized to whole frames at 30 fps on load; Ajustar ao WAV may rescale all durations to match the narration WAV.

transition_duration.description: Overlap for non-cut transitions, quantized to whole frames at 30 fps on load.

metadata.description: Free-form provenance (for example generated_by). Not used by the renderer.
